entities.summary: Christopher Ofili, is a British painter who won the Turner Prize in 1998. He has used resin, beads, oil paint, glitter, lumps of elephant dung and cut-outs from pornographic magazines as painting elements. Ofili's work has been classified as punk art. He currently lives in Trinidad. Chris Ofili was a authors & novelists from Manchester (b. 1968-10-10, Manchester). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
